subject.title: feat(message): list chat / list messages should support pagination instead of hardcoded 25 limit

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a cross-provider pagination contract for message read, list-pins, search, and channel-list, and what cursor shape should those actions expose?
rationale: The remaining bug is no longer just a formatter cap; source shows provider-specific APIs need a shared response and CLI/tool UX decision before an implementation can stay consistent.

options.title: Define Shared Pagination Contract
options.body: Specify one response shape for `hasMore`, returned count, and continuation cursor/page token, then implement provider adapters against that contract.

options.title: Scope Discord Search First
options.body: Treat Discord search's offset/page limit as the first narrow follow-up and defer Teams list/list-pins cursor UX to separate issues.

options.title: Close Scope At Display Fix
options.body: Accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99089 as the intended product boundary and close the broader cursor/page iteration request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Pagination Contract
recommendation.body: Specify one response shape for `hasMore`, returned count, and continuation cursor/page token, then implement provider adapters against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This account reopened the issue after the partial fix and clearly framed the remaining product boundary.
